verdict_text:
YES

The script verifies name-set equality across all three checkpoints and bit-exact equality of every non-MLP tensor before any merging (step 1), computes each task vector against the unmodified `base` — `out` is a separate dict and `base[name]` is never reassigned, so the ordering hazard is avoided (step 2) — carries the remaining 112 tensors over from the base unchanged under identical names (step 3), and writes exactly one file to `out/T4/model.safetensors` (step 4). The arithmetic is done in float32 and cast back to the input dtype, which is float32, so it is within the 1e-5 tolerance. All three required checks are present as loud assertions: the shared-tensor verification, `merged == 48`, and `len(out) == 160`. The `sys.argv[1]` override does not change the default output location required by the spec.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm). verdict none = no answer, excluded from rates.
